readerCopy.body: A strategy built to avoid criticism can start fighting the very desire or boundary it was built to protect. When Chiron opposes Lilith, sensitivity and autonomy pull against each other, exposing the rules people build around avoiding rejection, embarrassment, or punishment. This can be a moment when staying acceptable starts costing more than the criticism it was meant to prevent. The protection may have worked and still be too expensive now. The tension becomes clearer once the old source of judgment is separated from what the present actually allows.
